searchText: MSRP $178,325. New 2026 Thor Motor Coach Vegas RUV Model 26.1. This RV measures approximately 27 feet 2 inches in length and features a drop-down overhead loft, slide-out and a bedroom TV. The Vegas also features the new Ford E-Series chassis with a 7.3L V-8 engine and a six speed automatic transmission. This beautiful RV features the optional Electric Stabilizing system, exterior pull-out tray w/griddle, paint, power drop down overhead loft and power drivers seat. The Vegas also boasts an impressive list of standard features including the Winegard Connect 2.0 WiFi, rotary battery disconnect switch, adjustable shelving bracketry, BM Pro Multiplex system, power privacy shade on windshield, tankless water heater, touchscreen radio that features navigation and back-up monitor, frameless windows, heated remote exterior mirrors with integrated sideview cameras, lateral power patio awning with integrated LED lighting and much more.
